findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_locations" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use this to check whether Aisles covers a place, chain or mall before answering, or when the user asks where Aisles works. Lists the 191 metro areas with publis…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
